stock.description: As an investment holding company, Bar Pacific Group Holdings Limited operates a portfolio of bars and restaurants across Hong Kong, trading under the Bar Pacific, Katachi, Moon Ocean, and Pacific brand names. Its business activities are primarily categorized into two divisions: the operation of its diverse hospitality venues and property investment. As of March 31, 2022, the group maintained a network of 46 such establishments. Patrons at these locations can enjoy a wide array of beverages, including beer, cocktails, wines, and spirits, complemented by refreshments and various food offerings. Additionally, the company provides electronic dart machines and generates revenue from property leasing. Established in 1999, Bar Pacific Group Holdings Limited is headquartered in Hung Hom, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Moment to Moment Company Limited.
